letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. I still remember the sparkle in your eyes on our wedding day, 23 Feb 2025, and how our love has only deepened since. You are my anchor and my adventure, the calm in my desert and the rain in my garden. Thank you for filling each moment with laughter, warmth, and endless love. I adore you more than words can hold.
poem:
In deserts wide and rivers deep,  
Your smile’s the promise I’ll always keep.  
Through sand and rain, our hearts entwine,  
Together, love, forever shine.
